summary: New hire onboarding: cross-team access, loaner GPU laptop, and temporary elevated-priv policy clarification
description:
Issue summary: HR has scheduled a new contractor start (ML infra contractor) for 2026-03-16. Request covers account provisioning across GitHub, Okta, GCP (project: rwd-inference-dev), AWS dev account, Redwood Console access (read/write to dedicated test project), and a temporary loaner GPU laptop for two weeks.

Impact: Contractor cannot start without these accesses and hardware; onboarding will be delayed if not completed by 2026-03-16. There is also a policy question from Security about temporary elevated privileges for a contractor to perform hands-on kernel tuning in the GPU lab and whether 7-day sudo access approved for employees applies to contractors.

Environment: internal onboarding workflow, staging identity sync (okta-sync-staging), assets inventory (IT-asset-db), region: us-west (for laptop pickup).

Required by HR: - GitHub org read/write to repos: infra-runtime, perf-tests. - Okta groups: contractors-ml, vpn-access, console-dev-viewers. - GCP: viewer on rwd-inference-dev, compute admin on project for 14 days (for kernel tuning task). - AWS: IAM role assume access to dev-gpu-ops for metrics collection. - Loaner GPU laptop (NVIDIA A2000) for 2026-03-16 to 2026-03-30. - VPN account and laptop encryption check.

Policy question: Security asks whether a blanket 14-day compute-admin elevation for contractors is acceptable or if we should create scoped service accounts and ephemeral bastion workflow. Need explicit guidance and an exception approval (if needed).
impact: Onboarding delay for a contractor with direct effect on scheduled benchmarking work; potential security policy exception required
steps_to_reproduce: 1) HR submitted People Ops seat request for contractor (ticket HR-7298)
2) Automated Okta group sync did not add contractors-ml group to external contractor accounts in previous run
3) Asset inventory shows no GPU laptops currently reserved under loaner pool
4) Request an AWS/GCP role mapping which requires infra team's approval
logs: okta-sync-staging run logs (2026-03-09) show user-create events but group assignment step returned 207 Partial Success; refer to /var/log/okta-sync/2026-03-09.log line ~842
comments:
Priya Shah (Reporter) 2026-03-10: Adding this to internal-support as requested by People Ops. Contractor will start 2026-03-16 and needs access on day one.
People Ops ticket: HR-7298.
Please advise on hardware availability and any policy exceptions needed for compute-admin access.

Jamal Ortega (Assignee) 2026-03-10: I will run through the access checklist and confirm which items can be automated before start date. Tentatively reserving a loaner laptop; need IT asset team confirmation. Tagging Security for ephemeral privilege guidance.

Aisha Khan (Security) 2026-03-11: Contractors should not receive blanket compute-admin privileges. Suggest using a scoped service account with time-limited keys and short-lived bastion session (SSO + ephemeral credentials). If kernel tuning requires host-level sudo, require an approved exception via sec-exceptions@redwood and 2nd reviewer.
Action: Provide exact list of required admin actions so Security can approve a scoped exception if justified.

Jamal Ortega 2026-03-11: Noted. Reached out to the contractor manager for exact task list and duration. Also escalating okta-sync partial failure to infra automation team (INT-17431) to ensure groups are assigned for contractors created via People Ops.
IT Assets (via IT ticket) 2026-03-12: Reserved laptop serial LTR-3092 for 2026-03-16 pickup. Encryption pre-check scheduled for 2026-03-15.
investigation_notes: Okta sync investigation: current sync job skipped contractors-ml group due to naming mismatch between People Ops template and okta group slug. Hypothesis: recent group rename to contractors-ml -> contractors-ml-2025 not reflected in People Ops templates.
Asset pool: loaner pool capacity is limited; laptop reserved but backup plan required if laptop fails encryption check. Consider short-term cloud GPU credits as fallback.

GCP IAM approach: rather than compute-admin role, create custom role with permissions for compute.instances.get, compute.instances.setMetadata, and compute.projects.get for 14 days, paired with a service account impersonation flow and audit logs enabled.
resolution: Partial / temporary resolution provided: laptop LTR-3092 reserved and encryption check scheduled; Okta group assignment fixed for this user manually and automated sync bug filed as INT-17431. Security approved scoped temporary elevation pattern: create time-limited service account with explicit permissions and require contractor to use ephemeral bastion for host-level operations. Formal exception request path documented in Confluence and People Ops informed. Follow-up task: implement automated mapping fix and add contractor exception policy to onboarding checklist (due by 2026-03-20).
follow_up_actions: INT-17431 - fix okta-sync template mismatch (assigned to infra automation)
Create custom GCP role and service account for contractor access (assigned to cloud-ops)
Update onboarding checklist in Confluence to include contractor ephemeral-priv process (assigned to People Ops)
Confirm laptop encryption check 2026-03-15 and handoff on 2026-03-16
